title: A fake agent replays a scenario over ACP
body:
Nothing here can be tested against an agent: none is installed, and a real
one is not deterministic anyway.

## Proposal

`src/bin/fake-agent.rs`: an ACP agent over stdin and stdout that answers
`initialize` and `session/new` and, on each `session/prompt`, plays the next
act of a scenario file given on its command line. A scenario is JSON: a list
of acts, each a list of steps, where a step is one of the things an agent
can send: a text chunk, a thought chunk, a tool call with kind, title and
locations, a tool call update with status and content, a plan, a permission
request naming the option the test expects chosen, or a stop reason. A step
may carry a delay in milliseconds so streaming can be watched by eye.

The format is part of the program's interface and is versioned with it.

## Rejected

- Hand-written JSON-RPC in tests, bypassing the SDK. The SDK's agent side is
  the same code a real agent uses, so the fake exercises the real wire.

## Open

- Whether the fake also answers client requests it does not expect, such as
  a cancel mid-act, with something sensible rather than an error.
